text:
priya: Heads-up: Vendor (EdgeHub) asked for SOC2 exec summary, pen-test findings CSV, questionnaire PDF, and a signed attestation for marketplace listing. Need an ingest + redaction + presign flow. Who can take which piece?

dana: I can handle ingest + checksums. Will upload raw to s3://partner-ingest/edgehub/1734445555/raw and publish SHA256 manifest.

owen: I'll take redaction and a 1-page findings summary for the reviewers. Redaction scope: remove emails, IPs, API keys, user IDs, cert serials. Keep tool versions and CVEs.

legal-bot: Attestation must include: a statement that customer-identifying info has been removed, signatory name/title/date, and a short note on permitted disclosure.

si-integration: Marketplace requires a flat manifest JSON next to bundle with keys: partner_id, bundle_date, artifacts (CSV list), redacted_by, contact_email, presigned_ttl_seconds, sha256_manifest. We'll ingest that.

priya: Good. Use partnerships@redwood.ai as contact_email. Presigns should be at least 72h. Retention: raw golden copy 2 years (encrypted), redacted partner bundle 90 days.

dana: Presign command I'll use:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://partners/edgehub/1734445555/redacted/edgehub-bundle.zip --expires-in 259200
```

owen: I'll run redact job tomorrow 09:00 UTC, manual spot-check after. Expect first-pass by 1734447000.

priya: Owners: ingest=dana, redaction=owen, attestation=priya (legal loop), manifest=si-integration. I'll open tracking ticket and share link. Thanks all :thumbsup:
